clauses.text: Staff must limit system access to people the organisation has authorised.
Staff must remove system access when a role ends.
Staff must not share passwords with anyone.
Staff must log security-relevant events on the systems they administer.
Staff must report a suspected cyber incident to the service desk on the same working day.
Staff must take a backup of each critical system and test a restore every quarter.
A supplier with access to council systems must be assessed before the contract is signed.
A change to a production system must be approved before the change is made.
Staff may keep a small plant on their desk.
